summary: Fills an array of virtual objects through a vtable dispatch. Loads the base of the output buffer from a1[105] (offset 0x1A4), computes a size argument v3 = 2 * a1[23] + 4 (offset 0x5C), and when the element count a1[25] (offset 0x64) is positive, loops a1[25] times calling the vtable method located at *(a1[1] + 4) (vtable pointer at offset 0x4, method slot +4) with (a1, 1, v3). Each call result is stored into the buffer at base + 68, advancing by one DWORD per iteration. Returns the last stored result. Called by CodecModeSelect and ObjectSetupWithBoundsCheck.

local_names.a1: this: owning object whose vtable and array metadata drive the fill
local_names.result: output buffer base (a1[105], offset 0x1A4) and running call result
local_names.v2: loop iteration counter, compared against a1[25]
local_names.v3: size parameter = 2 * a1[23] + 4 (offset 0x5C) passed to the vtable method
local_names.v4: advancing store pointer into the output buffer, starting at base + 68

operations.description: Load result = a1[105], the output buffer base pointer at offset 0x1A4.
Compute v3 = 2 * a1[23] + 4 = 2 * (offset 0x5C value) + 4, the size argument for the vtable call.
Guard: the fill loop runs only while the element count a1[25] (offset 0x64) is greater than 0.
Loop from v2 = 0 up to v2 < a1[25], the element count at offset 0x64.
Indirect vtable call: method at *(a1[1] + 4) (vtable pointer at offset 0x4, slot +4) invoked with (a1, 1, v3); its result becomes the value stored in the buffer.
Store the vtable call result at *v4 (buffer base + 68) and advance v4 by one DWORD and v2 by one each iteration.
Return the last vtable call result (uninitialized undefined if the loop never ran).

unresolved: The vtable method being invoked (creation/registration of a virtual object) is unknown; its purpose is inferred only from the fill pattern.
The store base offset +68 within the buffer is derived from the raw code (a1[105] + 68) and has no independent evidence ref.
The return value is undefined when the loop is skipped (a1[25] <= 0).
The object class owning the vtable and array metadata is unknown.
